text: The system shall define the allowable values for the asset status field returned in detailed asset information, including whether a 'Senior-admin approval required' state applies and the conditions under which that state is populated.
The system shall validate search criteria format and data before returning matching records and shall define how invalid search input is handled.
The system shall define the outcome when an admin rejects a staged deletion request, including the resulting asset status and notification to the requester.
The system shall assign and display a 'Pending Operation Status' for a deletion request staged for senior-admin approval while it awaits approval.
The system shall document the rejection handling for staged workflow edits in FR-14, including the outcome when a senior admin rejects the edit.
The system shall validate each export request by verifying the selected assets and the requested export format, and shall return an appropriate error response when the request is invalid.

The system shall define the outcome when a senior administrator rejects a staged permission assignment under FR-19, including that the requested permission change is not applied and the staged request is marked as Rejected.
The system shall record a Rejected outcome for a replacement request when the top-level approval step is denied.
The system shall set the operation status of a replacement request to 'Rejected' when the replacement approval decision is rejected.
The system shall identify the requesting user role when an asset request is submitted.
The system shall validate the format and data of the approval form input (decision, reason) before processing the approval decision.

The system shall record an asset change event when an asset is modified, including the change time, operation, user, and before/after values, so that the event is available to the View Asset Change History function.
